intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A courtier hurrying past presses a little tart into your hand. Three glossy red berries sit on top, around a spiky leaf.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: You get it halfway to your mouth. Then a gloved hand swats it out of your fingers.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She picks the tart up by its very edge and holds it at arm’s length, like a specimen.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Holly. Lovely on a wreath. Terrible in a person.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “I’m Senna. Infirmary. You’d have met me in about an hour.”

options.labelText: “You saved my life! Thank you. Seriously, you’re incredible.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “I saved you two days in bed. Your life was never involved.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Calm down. Be grateful at the correct size.”

options.labelText: “How could you tell from over there? It looked like a currant to me.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Currants hang in strings. Holly sits in tight clumps, and every berry has a tiny black dot at the tip.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Also, yours came with a leaf. Someone garnished your tart with a wreath.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She drops the berries into a vial labeled *NOT FOOD*. The vial is already half full.

options.labelText: “I knew. I was just seeing if you’d notice.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Next time, test me with your mouth shut.”
